name: Jashub
overview: The name Jashub appears in Scripture as a figure associated with distinct family lines, highlighting the importance of lineage in God's unfolding plan. In Genesis 46:13, Jashub is identified as a son of Issachar, also called Job, illustrating a variation in the name. Numbers 26:24 references the family of the Jashubites, indicating a clan descending from Jashub, while Ezra 10:29 lists a Jashub among the sons of Bani, showing the name's presence in different tribal contexts. These references collectively emphasize Jashub's role within the genealogical framework of Israel.
